title: 第二十五章 邀请第二十六章 宴会
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工

“当然。”林奇虽然不知道为什么玛琳娜会在这个时间段出现，但他知道，一定要和玛琳娜打好关系。
因为她不光是帕克图蒙迪商会的继承人还会在3.0版本的主线中成功成为了卡特里西亚共和国的主席。
如果说伊莱娜是反对贵族统治的阶级斗士，那玛琳娜就是坚定的资本主义战士。
对于崇尚契约和金钱的卡特里西亚共和国来讲，只要拥有金钱就可以得到一切。
收到林奇肯定的林克才慢慢打开了房门，露出了身后跟着的少女。
少女一头金色的波浪秀发垂与双肩之前，头上带了一顶黑色的透纱礼帽，一身镶钻的黑色礼裙，手上挎着一个黑色的包。
巴掌大的小脸上露出礼貌的微笑，琥珀色的瞳孔仿佛能看穿人心，高挺的鼻梁和涂了口红的小嘴更为这张脸添了一丝魅惑。
“您好，伊萨里斯少爷。”走进房间的玛琳娜对着林奇伸出了戴着黑色手套的手。
“您好，玛琳娜小姐。”从沙发上站起来的林奇握住了对方递过来的手。
“伊萨里斯少爷今天光临帕克图蒙迪商会是有什么需求吗？我们肯定会尽量满足的。”打完招呼的两人于沙发上落座，玛琳娜并未先展示来意而是问了林奇一句。
“打算收购一个名叫【不破誓约】的禁物，顺便挑几位工匠把我的庄园重新装修一下。”林奇不动声色。
“原来如此，禁物的话可能需要几天时间，帕克图蒙迪商会一定会竭尽所能帮您找到它的，至于工匠我一会儿会安排两人前往您的庄园。
请放心，都是总部精挑细选的工匠，技术这方面您大可放心。就当作今天和伊萨里斯少爷您初识的见面礼。”玛丽娜对着林奇微微一笑说道。
“感谢您的慷慨，玛琳娜小姐。”林奇对着玛琳娜做了一个贵族感谢礼后接着说道：“您是最近才来到维里迪亚王国吗？”
“当然，这个国家非常不错，风景很好，我很喜欢。”
废话，维里迪亚和卡特里西亚共和国不同，这里可是封建贵族制，对于玛琳娜这种老钱来说这里简直就是天堂。
在卡特里西亚共和国因契约的存在，普通人是拥有收入的，哪里像维里迪亚一样什么人口贩卖、廉价劳动力、卖身契、这些种种利于贵族统治的东西存在。
玛琳娜看着维里迪亚的国家制度口水都要流出来了，她都不敢想象这个世界居然还有这种廉价劳动力，居然不用开工资，只需要有个贵族身份，管口饭吃，就能得到一个听话的仆人。
“玛琳娜小姐今天来见我应该不光是为了寒暄吧？”林奇抿了一口林克送进来的红茶对着对面沙发上的玛琳娜说道。

“伊萨里斯少爷果真料事如神，最近帕克图蒙迪商会打算举办一场宴会不知道您感不感兴趣？”
“宴会？”
“没错，就在一周之后的帕克图蒙迪商会呢，我们邀请了很多王公贵族，就是不知道伊萨里斯少爷会不会赏脸了。”玛琳娜说着从包中掏出了一个鎏金信封递给了伊萨里斯。
叮——
触发支线任务，聚会与晚宴。
请参加帕克图蒙迪家族举办的聚会和晚宴并全身而退。
任务奖励：3000经验值、100金币、超凡武器【恶火】图纸。
“恭敬不如从命，我会准时到达的，玛琳娜小姐。”林奇收下了那个信封说道。
看这任务介绍这次聚会大概率是有危险的，但林奇依然要参加，完成任务是次要，主要是要在国都贵族中露个面。
要为了即将创建的事务所做准备，而玛琳娜所组织的这次聚会就是很好的契机。

"Of course." Although Lynch didn't know why Malina appeared at this time, he knew that he must have a good relationship with Malina.
Because she is not only the heir to the Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce, but also successfully became the president of the Republic of Catricia in the main line of version 3.0.
If Elena is a class fighter against aristocratic rule, then Marina is a staunch capitalist fighter.
For the Republic of Catricia, which advocates contracts and money, you can get everything as long as you have money.
After receiving Lin Qi's confirmation, Link slowly opened the door, revealing the girl following him.
The girl's golden wavy hair fell down to her shoulders. She wore a black organza hat on her head, a black dress with diamonds, and a black bag in her hand.
A polite smile appeared on the palm-sized face, and the amber pupils seemed to be able to see through people's hearts. The high bridge of the nose and the lipsticked mouth added a touch of charm to this face.
"Hello, Master Isharis." Marlena walked into the room and stretched out her black-gloved hand to Lynch.
"Hello, Miss Marina." Lynch stood up from the sofa and held the hand offered by the other party.
"Do you have any needs, Master Isharis, when you visit the Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce today? We will definitely try our best to satisfy them." After saying hello, the two people sat down on the sofa. Marina asked Lin Qi without showing her intention.
"I plan to acquire a forbidden item called [Unbreakable Oath], and select a few craftsmen to renovate my manor." Lynch remained calm.
"I see. If it's a forbidden item, it may take a few days. The Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce will do its best to help you find it. As for the craftsmen, I will arrange for two people to go to your manor later.
Please rest assured that they are all carefully selected craftsmen at the headquarters, so you can rest assured in terms of technology. Just treat it as the first meeting with you, Master Isharis, today. Marina said with a slight smile at Lynch.
"Thank you for your generosity, Miss Marlena." Lynch made a noble thank you to Marlena and then said: "Have you just come to the Kingdom of Viridia recently?"
"Of course, this country is very nice, the scenery is very good, I like it very much."
Nonsense, Viridia is different from the Republic of Catricia. This place is a feudal aristocracy. For old money like Marina, this place is simply a paradise.
In the Republic of Catricia, ordinary people have income due to the existence of contracts. Wherever there are human trafficking, cheap labor, prostitution, and other things that are conducive to aristocratic rule like Viridia.
Marina drooled when she looked at Viridia's national system. She couldn't imagine that there was such a cheap labor force in this world. There was no need to pay wages. She only needed to have a noble status and take care of the food, and she could get an obedient servant.
"Miss Marlena came to see me today not just for greetings, right?" Lynch took a sip of the black tea brought in by Link and said to Marlena on the sofa opposite.
"Young Master Isharis is really good at predicting events. Recently, the Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce is planning to hold a banquet. I wonder if you are interested?"
"Banquet?"
"That's right, the Paktumundi Chamber of Commerce will be held in a week. We have invited many princes and nobles, but I don't know if Master Isaris will reward me." Marina said, taking out a gilt envelope from her bag and handing it to Isaris.
Ding——
Trigger side quests, parties and dinners.
Come to the parties and dinners hosted by the Paktumundi family and come out safe.
Mission reward: 3000 experience points, 100 gold coins, drawings of the extraordinary weapon [Evil Fire].
"Respect is worse than obedience. I will arrive on time, Miss Marina." Lynch accepted the envelope and said.
Looking at this mission introduction, this gathering will probablyThe rate is risky, but Lynch still has to participate. Completing the task is secondary, and the main thing is to show his face among the nobles of the capital.
To prepare for the upcoming establishment of the firm, the party organized by Marina is a good opportunity.
